basic_details.job_title: TMC ACTREC Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Tata Memorial Centre Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (TMC ACTREC) has notified 1 contractual vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow post in Navi Mumbai. The project tenure is 3 years, with the pay specified as Rs. 45,880p.m. and the age limit as 28 Yrs. Eligible candidates possessing a B.S. 4 years programme /BPharm/MBBS/Integrated BS-MS/MSc/BE/BTech or equivalent degree, with 55% marks and passing of NET/GATE test, can apply by email. Applicants must send their CV, educational documents, caste certificate and Aadhaar card soft copy in a PDF format to the design

how_to_apply: Prepare your CV, educational documents, caste certificate, and Aadhaar card soft copy in a single PDF format.
Compose an email addressed to [email protected].
Set the subject line of your email strictly to “Application for the post of Junior Research Fellow”.
Attach the PDF containing your CV and required documents to the email.
Send the application on or before 30/10/2026 till 3:00 PM.
important_instructions: Applications must be sent via email to [email protected] in PDF format only. The email application must contain the exact subject line specified in the notification. The upper age limit of 28 years is relaxable up to 5 years for candidates belonging to scheduled castes/tribes/OBC, women, and physically handicapped candidates. Work progress will be monitored continuously, and extensions depend on performance reviews after 1 year. Only short-listed candidates will receive communication regarding interview details via email.

content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential qualification and eligibility requirements specified for the Junior Research Fellow position.

rows.essential_qualification: B.S. 4 years programme / BPharm / MBBS / Integrated BS-MS / MSc / BE / BTech or equivalent degree, with 55% marks and passing of NET/GATE test.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Junior Research Fellow will receive a fellowship of Rs. 45,880/- p.m., which includes Rs. 37,000/- plus 24% HRA per month. The project tenure is 3 years. content_sections.heading: TMC ACTREC Junior Research Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: The candidate selected for the Junior Research Fellow post is expected to perform the following duties and tasks: Perform cell biology, molecular biology, biochemistry experiments etc. (e.g. cell culture, flow cytometry, immunofluorescence imaging, western blotting, RT-PCR experiments) Animal handling and IHC Annotate and analyse data

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TMC ACTREC Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Prepare your CV, educational documents, caste certificate, and Aadhaar card soft copy in a single PDF format. Compose an email addressed to [email protected] . Set the subject line of your email strictly to “Application for the post of Junior Research Fellow”. Attach the PDF containing your CV and required documents to the email. Send the application on or before 30/10/2026 till 3:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only short-listed candidates will be contacted by e-mail and notified about the interview date and timings. The interview will be conducted in a hybrid mode. Candidates will have the option to confirm whether they will attend the interview in person or in online mode after receiving the short-listed email.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications must be sent via email to [email protected] in PDF format only. The email application must contain the exact subject line specified in the notification. The upper age limit of 28 years is relaxable up to 5 years for candidates belonging to scheduled castes/tribes/OBC, women, and physically handicapped candidates. Work progress will be monitored continuously, and extensions depend on performance reviews after 1 year. Only short-listed candidates will receive communication regarding interview details via email.

faq.question: Q1. What is the position advertised by TMC ACTREC?
faq.answer: TMC ACTREC has advertised the position of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) for the Patwardhan Lab, CRI.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 30/10/2026 till 3:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B.S. 4 years programme / BPharm / MBBS / Integrated BS-MS / MSc / BE / BTech or equivalent degree with 55% marks and must have passed the NET/GATE test.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit and is there any relaxation?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 years. It is relaxable up to 5 years for candidates belonging to scheduled castes/tribes/OBC, women, and physically handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the fellowship amount?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fellowship of Rs. 45,880/- p.m., which includes Rs. 37,000/- plus 24% HRA.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates apply for this post?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must send their CV, educational documents, caste certificate, and Aadhaar card soft copy in a PDF format to [email protected] with the subject line “Application for the post of Junior Research Fellow”.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates will be short-listed, and only the short-listed candidates will be contacted by email and notified about the interview date and timings.

faq.question: Q9. Is the interview conducted in person or online?
faq.answer: The interview will be in hybrid mode, giving candidates the option to attend either in person or online after receiving the short-listed email.

faq.question: Q10. Is there an application fee mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.
